label: Present-tense receipt of esse: a principle receiving a thing's act of being at a moment
definition: Receipt.ReceivesAt v z x t: in history v, at moment t, the principle z is receiving the act of being of x, that is, z stands to x's esse as receiving potency to received act at t. Explicitly identified PRIMITIVE relation; no axiom constrains it. It is the time-indexed counterpart of the tenseless EsseReceivedIn x z (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN), and it names the receiver side only: no giver occurs in it, and nothing ties it to BeingGiving.GivesAt (definition 158301bc) except the explicit open correlativity premise. Ordinary meaning: the air is receiving light at noon (occurrent), or a vessel holds water poured into it earlier (standing). Those two readings are its senses in the disambiguation 71d3bdb7: RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 (passion: being given esse at t) and RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standing composition: having esse in a receiving principle while present at t). The theorems stated over the primitive hold for every interpretation. Distinguished from the tenseless EsseReceivedIn (no moment), from GivesAt (agent side), from origin from another (RECEPTION_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_EXTERNAL_CAUSE_2) and from reception of a form in matter.
note: Analyst primitive, attribution deferred, introduced for the present-tense receipt test of attempt 21883b61 (docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md, section 5). Structural properties: none built in (not functional in z, several receivers of one esse are not excluded by the type, no persistence over time). OPEN: whether reception of esse is an occurrent passion, a standing composition, or something else, and so whether either sense is the faithful time-indexed reading of DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN. Would be sourced by a passage that states reception of esse in a tense, not one that only applies the tenseless relation.
